message.content:
The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5/US‑101 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major traffic jams, construction, or weather delays—a typical car would cover that distance in about **6 to 7 hours**.  

If you’re planning a trip, it’s a good idea to check real‑time traffic and road conditions (e.g., via Google Maps or Waze) before you leave, as rush hour in the Bay Area or on the I‑5 can add an extra hour or more.
